source_review.notes: Checked all fifteen primary references. CNCF and DORA platform guidance, Google Cloud discovery/foundation/planning guidance, AWS strategy/wave/cutover guidance, Microsoft wave/execution/decommission guidance, and Google SRE canary/launch guidance support the bounded current claims.

evidence: Reviewed migration-unit, typed-dependency, readiness-gate, wave, platform/support-capacity, coexistence-state, resource-authority, outcome-baseline and guardrail notation.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation keeps per-unit readiness, aggregate wave capacity, authority state and completion outcomes distinct.

evidence: Executed the synthetic readiness/wave audit and reproduced services=6, ready=3, conditional=2, blocked=1, selected=3, platform_units=9/10, support_units=6/7 and wave_gate=pass.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The selected ready services demand 3+4+2=9 platform units and 2+2+2=6 support units, both within declared limits.

evidence: Verified conjunctive mandatory readiness, per-dimension wave-capacity inequalities, state-specific single-writer authority and completion as target outcomes plus guardrails and retirement predicates.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The model correctly prevents an average score from canceling mandatory failure and separates target presence from completed outcome transfer.

evidence: Reviewed unknown dependencies, cold paths, poor platform fit, stateful workloads, dual writes, late traffic, queues/jobs/webhooks, schema incompatibility, shadow side effects, capacity concurrency, stale source authority, operator access, reverse-sync loss, legal holds, residual credentials and cost.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Coverage spans runtime, data, traffic, identity, trust, delivery, observation, people, recovery, compliance, portfolio and retirement boundaries.

evidence: Traced outcome/fit, inventory/dependency, readiness/capacity, authority, transition and completion invariants through assessment, wave planning, coexistence, data movement, cutover, fallback, stabilization and decommissioning.
invariant_checking.notes: The invariants prevent volume-only goals, hidden edges, readiness averaging, conflicting writers, improvised transitions and traffic-only completion.

evidence: Verified two services with identical target compute and traffic but different transfer of data authority, jobs, identity, observation, incident ownership, recovery and source retirement.
proof_review.notes: The differing operational independence correctly refutes target asset presence as sufficient proof of migration completion.

evidence: The asset-relocation counterexample is explicitly labeled a proof sketch and states construction, consequence and stronger completion evidence.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: No migration strategy, wave score, canary or vendor process is represented as a universal proof.

evidence: The readiness/wave audit is explicitly synthetic and disclaims real validation; worked examples are scenarios; vendor guidance is retrieval-dated; no real migration outcome is claimed.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: No real workload readiness, cutover, data validation, fallback, stabilization, cost reduction or external review is presented as observed evidence.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed outcomes/authority, discovery, dependency-coherent units, strategy choice, target contracts, foundations, conjunctive readiness, representative moves, waves, people, coexistence, data, shadow validation, rehearsal, progressive execution, authority transfer, fallback/roll-forward, stabilization, decommissioning and portfolio learning.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed implementability with multi-source inventory, typed graphs, explicit fit decisions, versioned contracts, platform/support capacity, migration states, writer fencing, replication/invariant checks, canary controls, cutover thresholds, incident authority, stabilization cycles, dependency scans, credential revocation and residual-cost closure.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified required order, one-page review, definitions and formulas, twelve-step mechanism, six invariants, bounded proof sketch, executable audit, eighteen trade-offs, thirty misconceptions, ten examples, ten connections, fifteen references, and five answered exercises.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
